articles.title: AI data centers on floating solar panels at sea
articles.description: San Francisco startup NetworkOcean has put OASIS-00 on the water in San Francisco Bay, a 20 kW floating solar array of sixteen floats that powers an Nvidia H100 GPU in a data center container aboard its support vessel.
